pure-announcement.rationale: This describes an enduring analytical framework (the DAMA Wheel and its knowledge areas), not a product launch or release.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest existing concepts (rare-context, agent-harness, mcp-abstraction-tax, cyclonedx-object-model, paved-road-mcp-platform, semantic-layer) touch data-management taxonomy.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The wheel and its ten knowledge areas are DAMA International's own published taxonomy, verifiable against the DMBOK2R book and DAMA's site.

durability.rationale: The wheel's structure - governance at the center coordinating ten stable knowledge-area disciplines - has held since DMBOK2 (2017) through its 2024 revision and names no version-specific detail.

actionability.rationale: It names the ten disciplines and their governance-centric relationship but stops at taxonomy - it does not show how to apply any single knowledge area, only that a complete program should cover all of them.

atomicity.rationale: The whole idea - one governance hub coordinating ten interconnected data-management disciplines - is stated in a single paragraph independent of the source's marketing framing.
